# Viking Takes Delivery of Newest River Ship in Europe


October 28, 2026 4:15 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_3b1adca64cafa0bc7fdcdca7aed7fa8f/vikingcruises/news/2026-10-28_Viking_Takes_Delivery_of_Newest_River_Ship_in_251.pdf)


*The Viking Haki Joins Award-Winning Fleet of Viking Longships*


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Viking® ([www.viking.com](http://www.viking.com/) ) (NYSE: VIK) today announced it has taken delivery of the **[Viking Haki](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/ships/longships/viking-haki.html) , the company’s newest[Viking Longship](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/ships/longships/index.html) ®. The 190-guest *Viking Haki* joins Viking’s award-winning fleet of state-of-the-art sister ships and will sail the company’s popular itineraries on the Rhine, Main and Danube rivers.


“Our river voyages offer an ideal way to explore Europe, bringing guests closer to the history, culture and traditions of the destinations they visit,” said Leah Talactac, President and Chief Executive Officer of Viking. “We are pleased to welcome the elegant *Viking Haki* to our fleet and to offer even more guests the opportunity to discover these remarkable destinations in Viking comfort.”


**The *Viking Haki***


Hosting 190 guests in 95 staterooms, the *Viking Haki* features elegant Scandinavian design and the industry-leading innovations for which Viking is known, including the patented square bow that enables three full decks, the indoor/outdoor Aquavit Terrace and the proprietary asymmetric corridor layout that allows for true two-room suites. The *Viking Haki* will sail popular itineraries, including[Rhine Getaway](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/cruise-destinations/europe/rhine-getaway/2027-basel-amsterdam/index.html) *,*[Grand European Tour](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/cruise-destinations/europe/grand-european-tour/2027-budapest-amsterdam/index.html) *,*[Danube Waltz](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/cruise-destinations/europe/danube-waltz/2027-budapest-passau/index.html) *and*[Tulips & Windmills](https://www.vikingrivercruises.com/cruise-destinations/europe/tulips-windmills/2027-amsterdam-amsterdam/index.html) *,* as well as Christmas Market itineraries.


**Viking’s Growing Fleet**


Viking remains focused on well-defined, long-term growth plans and its strategy to continue leading the way in experiential travel. Based on Viking’s committed orderbook, the company expects to take delivery of 17 additional river ships by 2028, 11 additional ocean ships by 2032 and two additional expedition ships by 2031. With these orders, Viking will have 114 river ships in 2028 and 28 ocean and expedition ships in 2032.


**Media Assets**


For more information about Viking, or for images and b-roll, please contactvikingpr@edelman.com .


**About Viking** Viking (NYSE: VIK) is a global leader in experiential travel with a fleet of more than 100 ships, exploring 21 rivers, five oceans and all seven continents. Designed for curious travelers with interests in science, history, culture and cuisine, Executive Chairman Torstein Hagen often says Viking offers experiences For The Thinking Person™. Viking has more than 450 awards to its name, including being rated #1 for Rivers and #1 for Oceans six years in a row by *Condé Nast Traveler* in the 2026 Readers’ Choice Awards. Viking is also rated a “World’s Best” by *Travel + Leisure* —no other travel company has simultaneously received such honors by both publications. For additional information, contact Viking at 1-800-2-VIKING (1-800-284-5464) or visit[www.viking.com](http://www.viking.com/) .
